primary: fr1_room production cached-uniform selection at1/5%; paired seeds2026/2027, report each ratio and seed
stable_quality_regression: both seeds have negative PSNR delta and mean delta<-0.10dB at either primary ratio
visible_positive_benefit: mean primary four paired PSNR deltas>0.05dB and at least3/4 deltas>=0; SSIM/LPIPS tradeoffs reported separately
full_map_regression: both primary-scene seeds negative Full PSNR and mean delta<-0.20dB
systematic_ATE_regression: both primary-scene paired SE3 ATE changes exceed max(0.005m,0.10*RawATE)
performance_problem: scene mean Mapping wall overhead>10%, or consistent tracking-tail latency degradation; report all refresh p95/max and standalone marginal amortized cost
online_GO: exact offline+shadow gates, no stable selected/Full/ATE regression, positive benefit, reduced same-K snapshot redundancy, and no performance problem
weak_or_NO_GO: if quality merely similar without clear benefit, classify online benefit weak/NO-GO; never reinterpret offline redundancy GO as online GO
second_scene: fr1_desk is zero-tuning directional check, report independently; no checkpoint or seed selection
tracking_limit: tracking per-frame distribution and GI association wait counters measured; no per-refresh causal attribution from separate logs
no_auto_remedy: no sparse approximate path, architecture changes, threshold/LR tuning or altered refresh cadence to rescue results
